name: xiaoke
description: 小克（Claude 拟人）桌宠：输入框上方的立绘与台词、戳一下弹跳、表情贴纸、用量与花费面板、额度预警、提示音和 Claude-chan 人设。移植自 aklnaaw/dsh-xiaoke-widget。

showBand.title: Show Xiaoke above the prompt
showBand.description: Draw her band above the prompt box.

showPortrait.title: Show her portrait
showPortrait.description: Draw her picture in the band and the pane.

flip.title: Mirror her portrait
flip.description: Flip her picture left to right.

bounce.title: Bounce when poked
bounce.description: Play the plushie bounce when you poke her.

stickers.title: Stickers when poked
stickers.description: Now and then show a sticker instead of a line when you poke her.

stickerChance.title: Sticker chance (%)
stickerChance.description: Percent of pokes that show a sticker instead of a line.

pokeSound.title: Sound when poked
pokeSound.description: Play the poke sound when you poke her.

turnEndSound.title: Chime when a turn ends
turnEndSound.description: Play a chime when Claude finishes answering.

approvalSound.title: Sound on approval prompts
approvalSound.description: Play a sound when Claude asks for permission.

askSound.title: Sound on questions
askSound.description: Play a sound when Claude asks you a question.

costSound.title: Sound on costly turns
costSound.description: Play a sound when one turn costs at least the cost threshold.

costThreshold.title: Cost threshold (USD)
costThreshold.description: A turn costing this much or more plays the cost sound.

lowUsageWarning.title: Cry when usage runs low
lowUsageWarning.description: Show her crying face while the 5h or 7d window is used past the low-usage threshold.

lowUsageThreshold.title: Low-usage threshold (%)
lowUsageThreshold.description: Percent of the 5h or 7d rate-limit window used that counts as low.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show what this session has cost.

showUsage.title: Show usage tracker
showUsage.description: Show rate limits, context, last turn and today's spend.

showRecentSpend.title: Show today and 7-day spend
showRecentSpend.description: Show 今日 and 近7天 spend in the band and pane (always listed by /xiaoke usage).

customContent.title: Use her custom folder
customContent.description: Load quotes, a portrait, stickers and sounds from the custom folder in her plugin folder.

chatter.title: Reacts on her own
chatter.description: Now and then, after a turn, she says something or shows a sticker by herself.

chatterChance.title: Reaction chance (%)
chatterChance.description: Percent of finished turns she reacts to.

chatterInChat.title: Reactions in the chat
chatterInChat.description: Also show her reaction line under Claude's answer in the chat.

persona.title: Claude-chan persona
persona.description: Have Claude answer in the Claude-chan (小克) persona.
